question: Does knowing that hidden true nature cause all-knowingness to arise?
premises: knowing hidden true nature precedes arising
the verse states a causal sequence
inference: Knowledge of the hidden true nature gives rise to all-knowingness.
uncertainties: the exact referent of taṃ is supplied by context
gūḍhasadbhāvaṃ may be adjectival or nominal
plain_english: Having known that hidden true nature, all-knowingness arises.
